bio: I'm a designer with a long-standing interest in green plants, natural landscape, and parametric form. Grasshopper sits at the centre of my daily workflow, paired with a Sketchup practice that I've extended with custom dynamic components. Energy and daylight tools — chiefly Ladybug — let me weave sustainability into early-stage design instead of as a late-stage check.

education.department: School of Civil Architecture and Environment
